title: Serpent (Tunjo) — Muisca
creator: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
provenance: The Metropolitan Museum of Art collection record for Muisca tunjo 1979.206.740, dated 10th–16th century and associated with the Guatavita Lake region.
notes: Contextualizes Muisca tunjos as offerings and records the association of Guatavita ritual accounts with the El Dorado legend.
Its description summarizes sixteenth-century Spanish reports; it is not itself a contemporary eyewitness source.
